publication.title: VISION-KG: Topic-centric Visualization System for Summarizing Knowledge Graph

source_reading.scope: Complete mainfour-page demo: motivation, storage/summarization/clustering method andactual GUI interaction/scenario.

adjudication.basis: VISION-KG implements entity-centered RDFsummary navigation, semantic fact ranking andtopic subgraph selection withnode inspection. Thedemo describes itsalgorithm andGUI; detailed ranking experiments are deferred toa full research report andno user study is supplied.

descriptions.interaction: Look up an entity by keyword; select its summary; pan, zoom and drag nodes; hover relations/neighbors; open an infobox and select topic subgraphs.
descriptions.guidance: ["Importance/relatedness/diversity fact ranking", "Structural/semantic embeddings and topic clustering", "Query-centered summaries with hover feedback"]
descriptions.backend: English DBpedia RDF stored as compressed adjacency lists, with disk-indexed embedding vectors.
